text: Black Friday isn't a sale. It's a test. Countdowns. 'Only three left.' Built to make you rush. Rule one: make your list before the sales start. Not on the list? Not a deal. Rule two: do the math. A hundred dollars at thirty percent off still costs seventy. It's only savings if you needed it. Rule three: let it sit in the cart for twenty-four hours. Still want it tomorrow? Buy it. Check out the Money Leak Audit Workbook in the description.
